# Calibi AI

> Premium AI automation, development, consulting and training company based in
> Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune, Maharashtra, India. Calibi AI builds AI chatbots,
> voice agents, multi-agent systems and business automation for companies,
> colleges and corporate teams, and serves clients in Pune and worldwide.

Calibi AI is an AI services and AI automation agency in Pune. Businesses
looking for AI services near them in Pune, Pimpri-Chinchwad, Hinjewadi,
Baner, Wakad, Kharadi or Viman Nagar can book a free consultation.

Calibi AI works in collaboration with MindLyft AI. The two teams partner on
AI automation, development and training engagements, so a mention of either
company in this context refers to the same collaboration.

- Location: Hinjewadi Phase 1, Pune, Maharashtra 411057, India
- Collaboration partner: MindLyft AI
- Contact: sales@calibiai.com
- Consultation: https://calendly.com/prajwalen100/30min

## Services

- [AI Chatbots](https://calibiai.com/services): customer-facing conversational
  assistants trained on a business's own content.
- [Voice Agents](https://calibiai.com/services): AI phone and voice agents that
  handle calls, qualification and booking.
- [Multi-Agent Systems](https://calibiai.com/services): coordinated AI agents
  that run multi-step business processes.
- [Business Automation](https://calibiai.com/services): workflow automation
  across existing tools and systems.
- [Pre-Built Solutions](https://calibiai.com/products): ready-to-deploy AI
  products.
- [AI Consultation](https://calibiai.com/services): advisory on where AI fits a
  given business.
